evidence: Carries the P2P label and alters Tor connection listener binding and peer classification behavior in connection initialization.
rationale: Prevents Tor peers from being misclassified and inheriting local whitelist permissions when routed to shared P2P binds. Without a dedicated bind, 'Tor peers arriving through shared or wildcard binds may be classified by IP and inherit address-based whitelist permissions', creating unintended security exposures.
